title: The kernel of a surjection from a finite free module onto a module of finite presentation is of finite type (Stacks 01BP(1))
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space (for instance a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with its structure sheaf) and $\mathcal F$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] of finite presentation, i.e. every point of $X$ has an open neighbourhood $U$ with an exact sequence $\mathcal O_U^{\oplus m}\to\mathcal O_U^{\oplus n}\to\mathcal F|_U\to0$ (Stacks, Modules, Definition 01BN). Let $r\ge0$ and let $\psi:\mathcal O_X^{\oplus r}\to\mathcal F$ be a surjective map of $\mathcal O_X$-modules. Then $\operatorname{Ker}(\psi)$ (the sub-$\mathcal O_X$-module $U\mapsto\ker\psi_U$) is of finite type: every point $x\in X$ has an open neighbourhood $V$ with a surjection $\mathcal O_V^{\oplus s}\to\operatorname{Ker}(\psi)|_V$ for some $s$ [pqf-def-coherent].
